[[File:OmegaSquad.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Omega Squad]]'s [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] were known to wear Night Ops armor]]
'''Night Ops Armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] suit that was used by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. Night Ops armor was typically painted [[Color/Legends|black]], and featured a special stealth alloy that shielded the armor against [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and made the wearer almost invisible to the naked [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. The armor itself was a derivative of the standard [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] that the clones typically used in other operations. Notable users include the [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos]] of [[Omega Squad]]. Omega mostly used white armor.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' this armor is available only in non-canon multiplayer mode.
